name: Poisonous Atmosphere

stealth.note: (expert) to identify the source of sudden nausea

description: Aucturn's poisonous, magical atmosphere has strange effects on the planet's creatures.
disable: DC 20 Survival (trained) or DC 20 Occultism (trained) to breathe pockets of safe air trapped in bags and clothing
routine: (1 action; illusion, mental, occult) The atmosphere continues to affect all creatures in the area, requiring a new Fortitude save each round against its Poisonous Atmosphere. A creature holding its breath gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the save.

generalAbilities.name: Poisonous Atmosphere
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-native creature breathes the atmosphere

Effect The triggering creature must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is invigorated by the atmosphere and is Quickened for 1 round.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Clumsy 1.

Critical Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.
